correctness.rationale: Sack chain tube functional telescopes to p_b−p_a; full tube fixes p_n−p_1=n^(2n). In intrinsic codimension-two affine tangent space, projected interval normals have norm sqrt(3/2) on an endpoint and sqrt(2) inside, giving a sharp summed radius bound from all n−1 adjacent tube facets. The unique gaps n^4+r_n nu_i have correct total and make every adjacent facet tangent. Longer r-gap intervals (2≤r≤n−2) have excess E=r n^4−n^(2r+2)+(r−1)r_n sqrt2 >0, since r_n sqrt2>n^(2n−2); so all others strictly noncontact. Equality in summed constraints forces the center. Independently checked small n=3,4,5,8 normal projections/inequalities, while the analytic proof applies to every n≥3. A source verification description claims n≤80 but bundled checker actually loops n=3..200; this is a benign description mismatch, not proof of infinite n.
